a: A failed step on an entry whose two halves share uncoalesced ops replays those ops twice while unwinding
A history without `branching` still rebuilds the branches it is about to drop, and a strict restore throws on them
A malformed snapshot whose `version` is a BigInt throws a TypeError instead of being refused
b: A branching history's kept branches grow without bound under `historyLimit`
A strict restore into a history without `branching` throws over branches it was going to drop
`snapshotFault` throws a TypeError for a BigInt or circular `version`, so a best-effort restore also throws
A restored branch whose `at` names no entry is kept forever and can never be reached or evicted
The `onEvict` doc lists the wrong set of evictions
